'''Behpour''' was a small and rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], too inhospitable to sustain any life despite having a breathable atmosphere.

==Description==
Behpour was a small arid planet very close to the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Star/Legends|sun]]. It had a core of green acidic lava that often burned its way to the surface forming lakes and rivers of acid. The acid burning up created amazing rock formations.

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_Behpour.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] on Behpour]]
Since its discovery by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], Behpour was primarily used as a secret laboratory. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Kul Teska]] brought his [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid army]] there to test his new [[Gravitic polarization beam|gravity weapon]], which was supposed to destroy Naboo's sun, proving Teska's worth to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. He captured [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she went to investigate reports of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Not long after, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic]] launched an [[Battle of Behpour|attack]] on the facility in three stages. First [[Cody/Legends|Clone Commander Cody]] and Clone Captain [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] attacked on [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] walkers to draw the droids' attention away from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who managed to sneak into the facility and deactivate the shield protecting it. Meanwhile [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] scaled a sheer cliff on [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walkers to reach the facility, then led the charge inside. At some point during the battle Skywalker liberated Amidala from Kul Teska and directed her to a power regulator. While Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Tano, fought Teska and his droids, Amidala managed to redirect power from the firing weapon back into the base. Skywalker and Tano killed Kul Teska and the two of them, along with Amidala, managed to escape the facility on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] before it was obliterated by a resounding explosion.
